message: test(onboarding): exercise the native hint button through the durable multiplayer server
purpose: Add a generated native mouse click on the real Got it button, verify it changes no economy/progression, and verify its persisted marker survives four real reconnects. Keep existing gameplay and inventory acceptance checks. Bound long button labels and avoid upgrade scans on unchanged inventories.

replacements.new:
Require(Self.Equipment.GetValueOrDefault("weapon") == weapon, "GUI-equipped item identity survives reconnect");
            Require(NewPlayerJourney.Seen(Self, "movement"), "Native guidance completion survives the real database-backed reconnect");

Require(Self.Discoveries.Count(x => x == NewPlayerJourney.HintKey("movement")) == 1, "Repeated reconnect neither loses nor duplicates acknowledged guidance");
                bool retainedSkillXp = checkpointSkills.All

replacements.old: if (FindUpgrade(data, after) is { } upgrade && !before.Inventory.Any(x => x.Id == upgrade.ItemId))
